purpose: Independent test observations for the frozen full-ring lower-bound material exclusion comparison
paired_noise: One independent complex Gaussian direction per material normalized to the Frobenius norm of the clean midpoint and scaled by the noise percentage
radius: Outward upper rounding of ||Y - clean midpoint||_F plus 10^-6 ||Y||_F
native_field: Reuse the native saved geometry and exact Arb forward field of generate_fields.py, including its 128-row enclosure chunks and residual correction
truth_ball: Require a positive outward lower bound on radius minus the outward upper bound on noisy-to-enclosed-field Frobenius distance plus residual tail
public_id_order: Assign opaque IDs by a once-generated random bijection retained only in the offline record, and publish observations in ID order
offline_labels: Keep seed and index mapping, material family, true peak and cap label separate from the public observations and generation receipt
selection: No candidate or method read, optimization, fitting, or exclusion during generation
